messages:
Rohan: Quick sync — I’m proposing a compatibility-gate rollout for API v2 over the next 6 weeks. Outline below. Need explicit owners for: JS SDK gate, Mobile SDK fallback, and runtime toggle. Please ack or flag blockers.

Rohan: Proposed milestones:
- Week 0: feature flags + canary routing enabled
- Week 1-2: SDK gates (JS, Py, Mobile) + smoke tests
- Week 3: customer beta cohort + support playbook
- Week 4-5: wider migration window (gradual traffic shift)
- Week 6: deprecation window start for old endpoints

Rohan: Owners I have so far: Py SDK -> Maria, Runtime toggle -> Sneha, Rollback/runbook -> Ben. Missing: JS SDK owner, Mobile SDK owner, comms owner.

Kevin: Ack — I’ll take the JS SDK gate. I’ll add a canary test job in CI that validates both old and new path results (sanity only).

Kevin: Quick note: PR to add smoke test will be up by EOD -> https://git.internal/rw/js-sdk/pulls/212 (draft).

Maria: Ack for Python SDK. Question — what migration window are we targeting? 30 or 60 days? We need to align with SDK minor releases.

Rohan: Leaning toward 60 days to give customers time, but we can do 30 for beta cohorts. Longer helps with third-party integrators.

Sneha: On the runtime side I’ll add a migration toggle that routes based on header + prefix cache. Need confirmation on schema changes — are we doing additive only? Any breaking shape changes?

Ben: We’re planning additive changes only for this rollout. For unavoidable breaking changes we’ll provide compatibility adapters at runtime. Note: adapters will add ~5-12% CPU on the hot path, so we should gate them behind opt-in flags during the shift.

Ben: Example runtime flag config: 
```
compatibility_gate: 
  v2_enabled: true
  v1_fallback: true
  adapter_mode: "on-demand"
```

Julie: Support here — we need a comms schedule and canned responses for when customers hit fallback. I can draft the KB if we finalize owner + window. Also please tag support in the beta cohort announcement.

Rohan: Julie — can you take comms owner for KB + email cadence? If yes I’ll add you to the migration board.

Julie: Yep, I’ll own comms. Will share draft by Wednesday.

Kevin: One more ask — can infra reserve 2 extra canary nodes for the JS SDK heat tests? They’re going to run concurrent sessions.

Sneha: infra-bot scheduled scaling job confirmed: reserve 2 nodes for 48h starting 1769958000. I’ll also add a short-lived route rule in staging.

infra-bot: auto-notice: scaling job queued by Sneha — 2 nodes reserved for js-sdk-canary (48h).

Maria: For Py SDK release plan — I’ll open a migration guide and add deprecation warnings in 1.4.x. Will coordinate with docs.

Rohan: Action items recap:
- Kevin -> JS SDK gate + CI smoke test (PR draft up)
- Maria -> Py SDK migration guide + deprecation warnings
- Sneha -> runtime toggle + reserve canary nodes
- Ben -> adapters + runbook for performance impact
- Julie -> comms + KB draft

Rohan: If no objections, I’ll mark these owners on the migration board and kick off the canary next Monday. Please react with :thumbsup: if you’re good, or reply with blockers.

Kevin: :thumbsup:
Maria: :thumbsup:
Sneha: :thumbsup:
Ben: :thumbsup:
Julie: :thumbsup:
Rohan: Thanks all — will update the board and send calendar invites for the weekly sync.
